objectiveRequirements.summary: CLI, Desktop, UI, release, updater, installers, docs, and live-DHT tests share one machine-readable acceptance matrix.
Desktop exposes bundled-UI route parity for data APIs, node and peer EPM/vCard, auth user routes, and provider/search routes.
Provider and data search are shared across CLI, Desktop, and UI with local, daemon/API, and live-DHT modes plus row, JSON, and CSV output.
Requester-facing provider commands cover list, search, show, connect/query, descriptor lookup, and data-standard filtering.
Encrypted conjunction assessment and private maneuver ephemeris workflows work across CLI and Desktop/UI with grants, channels, screening, export, and provenance.
Identity bootstrap, EPM/vCard wizard/export, QR/FlatBuffer output, and directory import/list/show/download are at parity across CLI, Desktop, and UI.
CLI and Desktop lifecycle controls cover start, stop, restart, status, service, and remove with data-preserve defaults and explicit purge.
macOS/Linux curl installer and Windows PowerShell installer are user-scoped, require no gh dependency, and have published-endpoint smoke coverage.
CLI and Desktop use the SDN-owned signed update provider path, stage/apply running-daemon updates in place, and cover rollback/failure behavior.
Main release lane publishes Desktop macOS, Windows, and Linux artifacts with release-body and website links.
README, CLI help, Desktop help/about, docs, and spacedatanetwork.org use SDN links, one-line installs, and private maneuver ephemeris messaging.
GitHub Actions/Docker live-DHT tests cover Linux Docker, native macOS, and native Windows on the public IPFS Kademlia DHT after a five-minute registration wait.
Desktop/UI smoke coverage proves parity is not CLI-only.

acceptance: contract lists every objective requirement
each capability maps to objective requirements
each capability names proving tests

Windows installer is PowerShell irm-pipe-iex from spacedatanetwork.org
installers initialize node identity without manual init
installers do not require gh, sudo, or administrator privileges for user-scoped installs
fresh installs create a mnemonic, node identity, and canonical encrypted EPM without overwriting existing secrets
show-identity and UI identity views work immediately after install
CLI exports EPM/vCard identity as text, JSON, CSV, FlatBuffer, and QR code
Desktop/UI serve canonical FlatBuffer-derived EPM, JSON, vCard, and QR artifacts where useful
CLI directory commands list, show, import, and download EPM/vCard artifacts
Desktop/UI directory search and download use the same local directory store projection
Desktop serves node EPM FlatBuffer and derived vCard/JSON artifacts through loopback-only routes
Desktop keeps encrypted size-prefixed EPM bytes as the node identity source of truth
Desktop serves peer EPM and vCard artifacts from hosted directory records
peer routes reject unavailable peers with explicit local API errors
Desktop implements bundled UI auth user create/update routes
admin-auth routes stay loopback-local and do not bypass host-header guardrails
CLI, Desktop, and UI expose the same schema/provider/source filters
row, JSON, and CSV output include consistent result fields
live-DHT mode uses public Kademlia DHT discovery rather than private-only networking
CLI, Desktop, and UI can query records by schema/provider/data-source filters
one live-DHT smoke path proves a cross-platform retrieval or query
Desktop route parity includes record bytes and length-prefixed FlatBuffer streams
provider search supports provider, schema, standard, source, and capability filters
CLI, Desktop, and UI show consistent provider descriptor and data-standard fields
live-DHT provider search uses public IPFS Kademlia DHT discovery
requesters can list, search, show, connect/query, look up descriptors, and filter by data standard
Desktop/UI provider detail and query flows consume the same descriptor/result contract
private maneuver ephemeris can be selected as an encrypted primary source
workflow accepts grant and private result channel identifiers
screening output exports result rows plus provenance

Desktop updater uses the same SDN signed feed and trust roots

main beta release lane builds Windows Desktop installer
main beta release lane builds Linux Desktop AppImage, deb, and rpm where supported
release body and website download links include every published Desktop artifact
README and docs use spacedatanetwork.org for installer/update docs
